notes: Sermon. The book's title page calls these 'Sermons' ('The Overcoming Life, and Other Sermons', 1896). No text is stated. Opening words: “A man when he says “I will,” may not mean much. We very often say “I will,” when we don’t mean to fulfil what we say; but when we come …” A related but different address from 'Eight “I Wills” of Christ' in Wondrous Love: seven points instead of eight, a different opening, and about a third of the wording shared. Kept as a separate entry.
